notes: Staged by chk-maps run 150, not yet imported (game-g2gfast held and out of scope). A linear skill-surf course (the page: 5 stages, easy to hard, 5-minute round, then a scout fight). Route read from the teleports: spawn box -> lvl.1 -> Level1_start -> lvl.3 -> wu -> Level2_start (red_wall) -> stagelast -> the teleport to `bob` at (9240 -15050 -5787), which also Enables the six start-disabled `tele` sweeps. The finish is the teleport to `bob`; the start-disabled `tele`, `ct_tele` and `t_tele` triggers (weapon rooms t_awp, ct_scout, ...) are the round-end sweep, not finishes. Verify in headless_imported before committing.

zones.note: round where the spawn box's teleport lands (lvl.1); the floor there is about 140 units under the destination, so the box is centred lower to hold the resting player
the CT spawns are in the weapon room, so name the course start rather than let the importer pick a team spawn
the last stage exit; enables the round-end tele sweep

round_teleports.note: start-disabled team/stage teleports the round logic switches on (knife fight, scout fight, stage sweeps); this game runs no round, so they were pits over the whole course
